# Plansel Group

> Family wine group in Montemor-o-Novo (Alentejo, Portugal), about one hour from Lisbon: the wine estate Quinta da Plansel, the vine nursery Viveiros Plansel, the Plansel International Wine School (WSET) and a weekly guide to wine events in Portugal. Website in Portuguese (main), English, German, French, Spanish, Chinese and Polish.

## Key facts
- Founder: Comendador Hans Jörg (Jorge) Böhm (born 1938 in Neustadt an der Weinstraße, Germany). He started in Montemor-o-Novo in 1975 with the first vineyards; the vine nursery Viveiros Plansel was founded as a company in 1981. Comendador de Mérito Agrícola (2006). Wikipedia: https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jorge_B%C3%B6hm · https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hans_J%C3%B6rg_B%C3%B6hm
- Quinta da Plansel: first wine in 1993 (with the University of Évora), own winery since 1997; run by the Böhm-Lindemann family; CEO and winemaker Dorina Lindemann (Geisenheim). About 400,000 litres a year, mainly Touriga Nacional, Touriga Franca and Tinta Barroca.
- Viveiros Plansel: certified grafted vines and clones of Portuguese grape varieties. According to the company, about half of the certified vines produced in Portugal each year come from Plansel clones. Research partners: Universidade de Évora, INIAV.
- Books by Hans Jörg Böhm: O Grande Livro das Castas (2007, OIV Award 2010), The Portuguese Vineyard and Wine Book, D. João Marquês de Montemor-o-Novo (2010), Livro Branco das Castas Vitícolas (2026).

## Awards: Mundus Vini (Meininger, blind tasting)
- Quinta da Plansel 25 Anos (1997–2022), unique edition: Gold
- Spring Tasting 2024: Gold for DL Dorina Lindemann Tinto Reserva 2021 and Plansel Grande Escolha 2019; Silver for Júlia Lindemann Tinto 2019 Limited Edition
- 2023: 6 Gold (Marquês de Montemor Reserva Tinto 2020, Plansel Trincadeira 2021, DL Reserva Tinto 2020, Plansel Touriga Nacional 2021, Plansel Touriga Franca 2021, Dorina Lindemann Limited Edition 2019) and 5 Silver
- Summer Tasting 2015: Gold for Plansel Selecta Reserva Branco 2014
- Dorina and Luísa Lindemann are official Mundus Vini tasters.

## What Plansel offers
1. Wine events in Portugal and international, updated weekly (eventos de vinho em Portugal)
2. Buy Plansel wine online: https://loja.plansel.com/
3. Buy certified vines and clones (comprar videiras certificadas): https://www.plansel.com/pt/index2.html
4. Stays and celebrations at the Quinta: apartments, motorhome pitches, weddings and company events
5. Tastings with Dorina & Luísa, bookable for a fee, in Europe and worldwide
6. WSET courses in Portugal (curso WSET em Portugal), in Portuguese and English
7. Bottling and consulting for small wineries
8. Grape and olive harvester with driver
9. Office, marketing and AI as a service for wineries (Plansel Technology)
